name: mirage
text: Sorry for the wait. Your screenshot (Engine > Money) has no Kalshi card because it is from the older app. Your 14:48 requests are done and released in v1.0.17 and v1.0.18: 1) Kalshi bids rest only when both 'bids' and 'Kalshi trading' are on, and both default to OFF, so none were resting. The Kalshi card now says which one is off. 2) Engine > Money now has a separate Kalshi card beside Novig's. 3) Yes, Bids-tab setting changes reach the GitHub engine. Update to the latest release and the new card will show. If it still says nothing is posting, send me a screenshot of it.
